# Portable PR327 complex supplier transfer

This package admits the strongest public PR327 p10 complex supplier for a
future outer assembly. Its fallback-inclusive coarse saving is exactly
`779597612622781/10^18`; no bit supplier or combined κ is claimed.

Run from a Python 3.11+ environment with the pinned NumPy/SciPy dependencies:

    python -B verify.py --output /absolute/fresh/external/output

The output must not exist. Every run checks every package byte, executes the
complete vendored public PR327 verifier (four anchors and all six producer
chains; typically about twelve minutes), expands the pinned strongest
certificate, then runs both exact scalar checkers and sign controls, both
complete reflected scalar/frame splices, twenty splice/global mutation
controls, the p10 five-stage ledger, the finite precision/row invoice and two
independent rational moment engines including next-grid exclusions. A saved
PASS receipt cannot replace either mandatory stage. Source bytes are checked
again before VERIFICATION.json is emitted.

The candidate has h=20, m=100, v=960, R=6455, W=10295; the five-stage ledger has
247575 calls, rank mass1027460 and deficit2040. Copied centres have rank18;
maximal child rank42 gives the completed-child induction gap115B. Actual cover
and physical-stock bit lengths, not p11 literals, determine the row charge.
The source permits the conservative stock bound10000 with inherited bit-coarse
reserve9909 and ordinary-leaf reserve252; the fresh physical stock fits that
bound and the retained exterior coefficient20161 is rechecked explicitly.

Generic `bankPrice h` and `bridge2_gcert` source statements supply the
h-dependent five-stage layout. The former is pinned under sources/ and the
latter stays in the original vendored source pins. No Lean build is run here.
The conditional dirty-lift, Clifford geometry, common-grid recovery, complete
stream routing, finite-cover and analytic interfaces remain inherited.

An outer package must call this verifier freshly, bind VERIFICATION.json and
SUPPLIER-CHECK.json, then recertify the chosen complex profile in its own
assembly. Historical binding-side notes in the unused p11 reference vendor
have no bearing on which supplier binds a future assembly.
